data.title: bn-3vvm: Fresh-eyes review of post-pre.13 changes
data.description: Review append-only fail-closed and preflight parity fixes, FF-absorb D/F materialization ordering, safe directory replacement, and byte-preserving Unix symlink restoration. Full just check passed.

data.reason: Security review: no concerns. Net fail-closed hardening — byte-preserving symlink restore (workspace-scoped, faithful git behavior), remove_dir empty-only prevents untracked-work loss, append-only gate parity in --check/--plan, invalid globs now fail closed instead of silently disabling protection.
